notes.title: Update Notes for December 12th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Player view is now in third person
[*] Stats and weapons now use Gameplay Ability System, rather than previous custom built system
[*] Niagara and Chaos Destruction are enabled in game
[*] Console commands have been added to adjust mouse/gamepad sensitivity without having to enter options menu
[*] Audio sliders now correspond with FMOD audio system
[/list]
